Stay, Dine, and Explore at the Grand Canyon Caverns & Inn!
The Grand Canyon Caverns were created over 65 million years ago, formed within the limestone that was once the bottom of an ancient inland sea that divided North America. The Grand Canyon Caverns are several miles to the east of Peach Springs, AZ. They are the largest dry caverns in the U.S.! Owned and Operated by Havasupai. Cavern Inn Open 24hrs, Restaurant Open 12pm-8pm, Gift Shop Open 8pm-8pm and Tours available 9-7:30pm
Best Hidden Gems on Route 66
Discover the Grand Canyon Caverns Inn & RV Park and Campground: Your Gateway to Route 66 Adventure
If you’re searching for a unique and relaxing stay along historic Route 66, the Grand Canyon Caverns Inn & RV Park and Campground offers one of the most memorable lodging experiences in Northern Arizona. Nestled near Peach Springs and just a short drive from the Grand Canyon, this destination blends classic Americana charm with modern comfort—making it a favorite stop for road‑trippers, RV travelers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
Whether you’re exploring the legendary Mother Road, visiting the Grand Canyon, or simply looking for a peaceful desert escape, this property delivers everything you need for an unforgettable stay.
A Classic Route 66 Inn with Modern Comfort
The Grand Canyon Caverns Inn captures the spirit of vintage roadside travel while providing updated amenities for today’s guests. Travelers love the spacious rooms, friendly staff, and the quiet desert atmosphere that makes unwinding easy after a long day of adventure.
RV Park: Spacious Sites and Big‑Sky Views
RV travelers will appreciate the Grand Canyon Caverns RV Park , offering wide pull‑through sites, full hookups, and plenty of room to settle in. The peaceful high‑desert landscape provides stunning sunrise and sunset views, and the location makes it easy to explore nearby attractions without the crowds.
RV Park Highlights:
Full hookup RV sites
Easy access from Route 66
Clean restrooms and facilities
Pet‑friendly environment
Quiet, scenic desert surroundings
Campground: Sleep Under the Arizona Stars
For tent campers, the Grand Canyon Caverns Campground offers a serene and spacious setting perfect for stargazing, campfires, and reconnecting with nature. With minimal light pollution and wide‑open skies, this is one of the best places in Arizona to enjoy the Milky Way.
Campground Features:
Shaded picnic areas
Fire rings and open space
Access to restrooms and showers
Family‑friendly environment
Close to hiking trails and scenic overlooks
Perfect Basecamp for Northern Arizona Exploration
Staying at the Grand Canyon Caverns Inn & RV Park and Campground puts you in the ideal location for exploring some of the region’s most iconic destinations:
Grand Canyon National Park
Havasupai Trailhead (permit required)
Historic Route 66 attractions
Kingman, Seligman, and Williams day trips
High‑desert hiking and wildlife viewing
Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway or a full Southwest road trip, this property offers convenience, comfort, and authentic Arizona charm.
Why Travelers Love Staying Here
Guests consistently praise the friendly staff, peaceful atmosphere, and the nostalgic Route 66 vibe that makes the entire experience feel like stepping back in time. With lodging, RV sites, and camping options all in one location, the Grand Canyon Caverns Inn & RV Park and Campground is a versatile and welcoming stop for every type of traveler.

Grand Canyon Caverns & Inn
About the Caverns Inn: A Classic Route 66 Motel
Onsite Dining & More
We provide everything you need for a relaxing stay, including a classic diner onsite, a gift shop, and a recreational vehicle camping site with all amenities. All our camping guests can get their supplies from our onsite grocery store. The store contains everything you need for a fun-filled adventure, from freeze-dried meals for backpacking to last-minute amenities. Open Daily 12pm-7pm
Gift Shop
Apart from a gift shop stocked with Grand Canyon Caverns items, we have a 24 hour convenient store, vintage Route 66 gift shop, a Supai gift shop, and a jewelry shop dedicated to the waterfalls and the Havasupai Nation at the foot of the Grand Canyon. This is the place to be if you want a change from the regular urban and suburban environment. Gift Shop open daily 8am-7pm
Nearby Attractions
The motel is adjacent to the beautiful Supai Falls and a few meters away from the rafting on the Colorado River and the Grand Canyon. It is the ideal home base for exploring the great adventures around the Grand Canyon in Northern Arizona.
Natural Wonders
With miles of hiking trails and over 800 acres of jungle forest, you can enjoy a unique experience full of memories. At 5,397 ft elevation, we are located on an appealing plateau with the most extensive caverns in the U.S. approximately 300 feet below the surface.
The Grand Canyon Caverns Airport (L37)
The L37 is a public airport that belongs to Grand Canyon Caverns & Inn, LLC. It has a 5,100 x 45 ft runaway at a 5,397 ft elevation.
We welcome flying clubs and are located within biking or walking distance away from the Grand Canyon Caverns. We do not offer fuel service. However, you can find KIGM Kingman fuel service to the southwest.

Grand Canyon Caverns & Inn
Filming Locations
The newest location under the sun, as well as under the ground.
Location is an important consideration when it comes to filming and photo shoots. You want your shots to look as beautiful and professional as possible. If you are searching for a place that offers these and many other interesting features, search no further than our Grand Canyon Caverns & Inn.
About Our Grand Canyon Cavern Filming Location
This natural limestone cavern is a truly unique film location. It is situated 210 feet underground and is currently available for the production of commercial film and photography.
We offer the best and most unique scenic locations in the Southwest. You can access this location by driving or flying from L.A., Phoenix, and Las Vegas. The Grand Canyon Caverns filming location is a true wonder and a perfect place to create superb films and photos.
The caverns are home to several rare trees, hills, and animals, making it a popular destination for professional adventurers, photographers, and filmmakers.
We offer a variety of services and amenities, including:
A 60’s gas station
A motel
Full rodeo arena
Modern RV parks

800 acres of rolling hills with trees
